data.description: Spacious 1BR in Torch Tower | High Floor | Marina Lifestyle
data.long_description:
Experience upscale waterfront living in this generously sized 1-bedroom apartment in Torch Tower, one of Dubai Marina’s most iconic residential skyscrapers. Known for its prime location and breathtaking views, this property offers a perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and investment potential.


  The apartment features a bright and spacious layout with large floor-to-ceiling windows, allowing for abundant natural light and stunning marina or city views. The modern kitchen is fully fitted, while the bedroom offers ample storage with built-in wardrobes. Ideal for both end-users and investors seeking strong rental returns in a high-demand area.

Property Details:

 1 Bedroom Apartment
 Size: 978.12 Sq.Ft.
 2 Bathrooms
 Spacious living and dining area
 Fully fitted modern kitchen
 Built-in wardrobes
 Balcony with Marina/City views
 Central air conditioning
 Covered parking space

Key Features:

 Located in one of Dubai Marina’s tallest towers
 High-floor unit (if applicable)
 Excellent layout with large living space
 Floor-to-ceiling windows
 Strong rental yield potential
 Walking distance to Marina Walk
 Well-maintained building with premium facilities

Amenities:

 Temperature-controlled swimming pool
 Fully equipped gymnasium
 Sauna and steam rooms
 24/7 security and CCTV
 High-speed elevators
 Concierge and reception services
 Kids’ play area
 Retail outlets and supermarkets nearby

Nearby Location:

 Walking distance to Marina Walk
 5 minutes to JBR Beach
 7 minutes to Dubai Marina Mall
 10 minutes to Palm Jumeirah
 15 minutes to Mall of the Emirates
 Easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road and public transport

Why Invest in Dubai Marina:

  Dubai Marina remains one of the most sought-after waterfront communities in Dubai, offering vibrant lifestyle, excellent connectivity, and consistently high rental demand. It is ideal for both investors and residents seeking luxury urban living.
